name: HH breakout 07 — volatility-adjusted channel break (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: classic Donchian/Turtle convexity — ~33% win rate but ~5x avg-win/avg-loss because a few breaks catch persistent crypto trends lasting weeks. A break to a NEW multi-week range extreme means prior overhead supply is exhausted (nobody trapped above), so there is no natural seller. The other side is mean-reversion traders fading the new high who get run over. Upgrade vs naive Donchian: require adx ABOVE a trend floor so range-bound whipsaw regimes are filtered, and require atr ABOVE a floor so the break auto-widens in high-vol regimes (fewer whipsaws — the volatility normalization). Enter long on range_position at the up-extreme with both filters live. bar_size 4h to ride multi-day trends while paying fees only on real regime changes. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if it fails to beat buy-and-hold net of fees on the holdout (the Gate's own beat-BnH test; trend-following in a chronically-up tape usually loses to holding) — OR if maxDD exceeds 25% (the fat left tail of the 67% losing trades) — OR if removing the adx trend-floor does not degrade it (adx is decorative and the edge is pure lucky-tail momentum that will not replicate).
catalyst: break to a new multi-week high with trend and vol confirmation
